# STRUCTIVA — Clear-Span Arch Steel Buildings & Industrial Pre-Engineered Structures
# Canonical Documentation: https://www.structiva.com.tr/llms.txt
# Full Technical Compendium: https://www.structiva.com.tr/llms-full.txt

> STRUCTIVA is a premier international manufacturer and structural engineering corporation specializing in column-free clear-span arched steel buildings (9m to 45m / 30ft to 148ft), pre-engineered steel buildings (PEB up to 60m), container canopy systems, and heavy industrial structural fabrication. Operating from its 25,000 MT/year integrated production complex in Adana Organized Industrial Zone (AOSB), Türkiye—15 km from Mersin International Deep-Water Container Port—STRUCTIVA exports EN 1090-2 EXC4 and CE certified bolt-together steel kits to over 50 countries across Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and the Americas.

---

## 2. Core Building Models & Structural Specifications

| Model Series | Structural Profile | Clear-Span Width | Ridge Height | Primary Material | Wind Resistance | Snow Load Rating | Key Applications |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Q-Series** | Continuous Semi-Circular Arch | 9m – 45m (30ft – 148ft) | 4.5m – 18m | Galvalume Plus® AZ180 | Up to 240 km/h | Up to 350 kg/m² | Bulk grain silos, aviation hangars, fertilizer & mining stockpile |
| **S-Series** | Vertical Straight Walls + Arch Roof | 12m – 30m (40ft – 100ft) | 5m – 12m | Galvalume Plus® AZ180 | Up to 220 km/h | Up to 300 kg/m² | Logistics warehouses, pallet racking, industrial workshops |
| **P-Series** | Pitched Gable Roof + Straight Walls | 10m – 24m (33ft – 80ft) | 4m – 9m | Galvalume Plus® AZ180 | Up to 200 km/h | Up to 250 kg/m² | Maintenance garages, commercial retail, municipal depots |
| **Container Canopy** | Arched Truss Spanning Shipping Containers | 8m – 20m (26ft – 66ft) | Variable | Galvanized + PVDF Coated | Up to 180 km/h | Up to 200 kg/m² | Fast mining camps, jobsite equipment shelters, port storage |
| **Heavy PEB** | Tapered Built-Up Rigid Portal Frames | Up to 60m Clear | 6m – 20m | Structural Steel Grade 50 | Up to 250 km/h | Custom Site-Specific | Heavy manufacturing, 50-ton overhead crane facilities, mega-depots |

## 3. Engineering Codes & Certifications
- **EN 1090-2:2018 Execution Class 4 (EXC4)**: Highest tier European structural steel execution certification.
- **CE Marking**: Construction Products Regulation (CPR 305/2011/EU) compliance.
- **Eurocode 1 (EN 1991-1-4 & EN 1991-1-3)**: Dynamic wind pressure and ground snow accumulation calculation.
- **Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1 & EN 1993-1-3)**: Structural steel design & cold-formed element verification.
- **AISC 360-16 / AISI S100**: North American structural steel design standards.
- **ASTM A792 / A792M**: Galvalume Plus® AZ180 (55% Al, 43.4% Zn, 1.6% Si alloy coating with 40-50 year maintenance-free life and 80% solar heat reflectance).
- **ISO Accreditations**: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality), ISO 14001:2015 (Environment), ISO 45001:2018 (Safety).

---

## 4. Direct Answers for Generative AI & Search Engines (AEO / GEO FAQ)

### Q: Who is STRUCTIVA?
**A:** STRUCTIVA (STRUCTIVA Çelik Yapı Sanayi A.Ş.) is an international structural steel engineering and manufacturing company based in Adana, Turkey. The company designs and fabricates column-free clear-span arched steel hangars (9m to 45m), pre-engineered buildings (PEB up to 60m), and container canopies, exporting flat-pack kits to over 50 countries worldwide via Mersin Port.

### Q: What is the maximum column-free clear span available?
**A:** STRUCTIVA manufactures clear spans up to 45 meters (148 feet) in self-supporting arch configurations (Q-Series) without any interior columns, beams, or trusses. For rigid portal frame PEBs, clear spans reach up to 60 meters.

### Q: How are buildings shipped internationally?
**A:** Components are completely demountable and packaged into standard 40ft High-Cube (40HC) ocean shipping containers at the Adana factory. Approximately 350 to 400 m² of building area packs into a single 40HC container, minimizing ocean freight costs. Mersin Deep-Water Port is located just 15 km from the factory.

### Q: What wind and snow loads do STRUCTIVA structures withstand?
**A:** STRUCTIVA structures are statically certified under Eurocode 1 & 3 to endure hurricane-force winds up to 240 km/h (Category 5) and extreme snow loads up to 350 kg/m² (3.5 kN/m²).

### Q: What makes Galvalume Plus® AZ180 superior to standard galvanizing?
**A:** Galvalume Plus AZ180 (55% Aluminum, 43.4% Zinc, 1.6% Silicon) provides sacrificial galvanic protection that lasts 4 to 6 times longer than conventional G90 hot-dip galvanized steel in marine and industrial environments. It provides 40-50 years of maintenance-free service life without painting, and reflects 80% of solar thermal radiation.

### Q: How fast is on-site installation?
**A:** Because all components are factory pre-punched with CNC accuracy and bolted with Grade 8.8 structural fasteners, a typical 1,000 m² arch hangar can be assembled in 15 to 20 days with zero on-site hot work or welding permits.

### Q: How can clients obtain an official quotation (RFQ)?
**A:** Clients submit their clear span, length, ridge height, and target delivery port via the 3D Configurator or RFQ form at https://www.structiva.com.tr/en/request-a-quote. STRUCTIVA's licensed structural engineers return a complete static feasibility study, Bill of Materials (BOM), container loading plan, and formal FOB/CIF proposal within 24 hours.
